rule: End by calling review_submit once with your verdict. Read only; change nothing.

reviewBrief.title: Add pagination helpers
reviewBrief.brief: Add pageCount and pageOf to src/pagination.ts so every item appears on exactly one page. pageCount(total, size) is the number of pages, and a partial last page counts.
reviewBrief.diff:
diff --git a/src/pagination.ts b/src/pagination.ts
--- a/src/pagination.ts
+++ b/src/pagination.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+export const pageCount = (total: number, size: number): number =>
+  Math.floor(total / size);
+
+export const pageOf = <T>(items: ReadonlyArray<T>, page: number, size: number): ReadonlyArray<T> =>
+  items.slice(page * size, (page + 1) * size);
